//: Application scopes of ef-track (container and vessel tracking). Use with --scopes-preset ef-track, or as a starting point for your own --scopes file. tenant:* and platform:* permissions are not listed: they always come from the template.

scopes.name: tracking:lookup
scopes.description: One-shot lookup of a container or booking number

scopes.name: shipments:read
scopes.description: List and read tracked shipments and their events

scopes.name: shipments:refresh
scopes.description: Refresh a tracked shipment from the carrier now

scopes.name: vessels:read
scopes.description: Vessel registry, tracked vessels, MMSI lookup providers

scopes.name: vessels:mmsi:manage
scopes.description: Look up and set vessel MMSIs
